speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old male. The patient reports experiencing left-sided chest pain and a productive cough with purulent sputum for the past week. He mentions shortness of breath. States he was diagnosed with influenza recently but did not adhere to the treatment plan provided.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (Left Lower Lobe). The patient's symptoms of productive cough with purulent sputum, pleuritic chest pain, and shortness of breath, combined with a recent untreated influenza infection, are highly suggestive of pneumonia. I request a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of the infection. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
